summary: Source-reviewed rework closed the worker-4/worker-6 ticket: primary Table 1 supports the MIC/database rows, the peptide-synthesis section supports asCATH1/asCATH2 identities and sequences, hemolysis values are accepted only where the local primary text/figure supports them, and figure-only exact database values remain explicit cautions instead of hidden conflicts.
adjudication_summary: Accepted with cautions after bounded local source recovery and row-by-row database adjudication; no blocking or major ticket remains open.

materials_exhausted.note: Local XML/PDF/packet extracts, landed OA/PDF/XML assets, landed supplementary captures, and merged database rows were reopened. XML metadata indicates no true PMC supplement; landed supplementary files are HTML captures rather than structured data supplements.

per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: Worker-4 source-reviewed the 26 linked DBAASP/CAMP/dbAMP rows against primary peptide sequence, Table 1, Figure 4/text, article metadata, and merged sequence/catalog rows. Two exact figure-derived hemolysis rows remain source_conflict with explicit context; the rest of the linked rows are source_verified.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: Worker-6 final activity evidence retains source-supported Table 1 MIC values and primary-text hemolysis findings; duplicate scaffold candidate rows and unsupported figure-only exact values are not promoted to final exact rows.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: Mechanism evidence is bounded to direct growth inhibition, hemolysis/cytolysis context, and IL-8 immunomodulatory expression assays; no receptor or molecular killing mechanism is inferred.
per_layer_decision_rationale.review_gate: The prior blocking ticket is closed because source review is complete for the owned worker-4/6 layers and all remaining uncertainty is represented as cautions rather than missing rework.

caution_findings.evidence_context: DBAASP/CAMP use 8% hemolysis at 1.24 µM; the primary text gives 7.54%, so rounded database values are retained with a source-reviewed caution.
Exact 50% hemolysis at 150 µM is not present in local text/table extraction and is preserved as source_conflict rather than normalized.
Figure 3/4 curves were source-reviewed for context, but only text/table-supported exact values are recorded as final exact rows.
LL-37 MIC rows are preserved as comparator/control evidence and are not database-linked Atlantic salmon cathelicidin entities.
Mechanism labels are bounded to growth inhibition, host-cell lysis context, and IL-8 expression response.
The packet lists supplementary captures, but file typing showed HTML documents and XML metadata reports no supplement; no source-supported supplement value is missing from worker-4/6 closeout.
